answer: An admission auction stops bulk fakes by selling scarce slots: 200 open each epoch, top bids win, deposits lock 20 epochs, refunded for honest work. A newcomer bids, posts its deposit, a pearl in a public vault; peers may challenge it, and a proven fake loses both. At 90 units a slot, 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 90 = 90,000 units, and flooding the ocean of bids only raises the price. An honest agent pays 90 once, roots like a willow and is refunded.
